Location

Novotel Bur Dubai Hotel is located in Dubai. This hotel is located in 5 km from the city center.

At the hotel

Spend an evening in a nice atmosphere of the bar. You can stop by the restaurant. Want to be always on-line? Wi-Fi is available. Also, the following services are available for guests at the hotel: a massage room and a spa center.

Sports fans will be able to enjoy a gym. Swimming fans are going to enjoy an outdoor pool. For the free movement around the city, the hotel offers a transfer for you. Accessibility: there is an elevator/lift.

There are other services available for the guests of the hotel. For example, a laundry, dry cleaning, private check-in and check-out, ironing and a concierge.

Room amenities

Guests will find the following in the room: a TV, a mini-bar and a bathrobe. Please note that the listed services may not be available in all the rooms.

hotelDetailMap.title: Description
hotelDetailMap.data:
Location

Novotel Bur Dubai Hotel is located in Dubai. This hotel is located in 5 km from the city center.

At the hotel

Spend an evening in a nice atmosphere of the bar. You can stop by the restaurant. Want to be always on-line? Wi-Fi is available. Also, the following services are available for guests at the hotel: a massage room and a spa center.

Sports fans will be able to enjoy a gym. Swimming fans are going to enjoy an outdoor pool. For the free movement around the city, the hotel offers a transfer for you. Accessibility: there is an elevator/lift.

There are other services available for the guests of the hotel. For example, a laundry, dry cleaning, private check-in and check-out, ironing and a concierge.

Room amenities

Guests will find the following in the room: a TV, a mini-bar and a bathrobe. Please note that the listed services may not be available in all the rooms.
